name: NoticeKit
tagline: AI security questionnaire answers for SaaS teams.
summary: Browser-only AI security questionnaire answer workflow for SaaS teams handling buyer procurement, security, and privacy review pressure.
description: NoticeKit helps small SaaS teams answer buyer AI security questionnaires without sending questionnaire data to a server. The product includes a live answer builder, route chooser, deal-blocker path, repeat-review answer bank, software-fit scorecard, shortlist worksheet, ownership matrix, workbook-friendly exports, and paid starter, pro, and async audit paths.
audience: Startup attorneys and consultants supporting buyer review

pricing.free: Browser-only builder, answer-bank workspace, checklist, scorecard, and route tools.

core_features: Browser-only AI answer builder with CSV, TSV, and Excel questionnaire import
Route chooser and deal-blocker path for fast first-step triage
Reusable answer-bank workspace for repeated enterprise reviews
Response workbook and spreadsheet-friendly handoff paths
Software-fit scorecard, shortlist worksheet, and ownership matrix
Evidence-map, audit sample, kit preview, and purchase-next-steps proof routes
Due-diligence packet, framework map, and AI agent control routes
No account or server-side storage required for core free flows
